conventions: Read on audit/u35-braise2 against v1.29.0 (agent, 2026-10-27). As asy_print_log.json's conventions entry, not repeated per row: a C-stack overflow (MP_STACK_CHECK) is I.4(d.1)'s design defect, recorded by report_if_fatal() where it is caught, never a per-site raise; and a call allocating one fixed-size object per call site (a *args tuple, py/bc.c:163; an async def's coroutine, py/objgenerator.c:53-62; a dict view, py/objdict.c:550-551; an enumerate object, py/objenumerate.c:42; a boxed float; a generator expression; a list or dict of a schema's fixed field count, the schema being a const tuple tests_scripts/test_config_schemas.py checks) raises MemoryError only on an exhausted heap, which F.2 sends to I.4(a): a function doomed without memory does not catch. Where such a raise goes, by caller: setup() and construction run at boot only (from run_setups(), asy_system_service.py:738-746, which catches nothing, and from build_system()), so the generated entry's except BaseException holds them (build/generated_src/sensortask_<device>_main.py:38, buildgen/codegen.py:867); write_config() and get_dict() run from a module's _set_dict_cfg() or get_dict_cfg() on a REST route (asy_base_classes.py:803, :809; asy_system_service.py:267, :657), where Microdot's except Exception (ext/microdot.py:1533) and the webserver's errorhandler (asy_webserver_service.py:791) hold them; the typed getters run in a module's supervised task, whose end asy_system_service.py:326's except Exception in _log_dead_task() persists before the supervisor restarts it (I.4(c)); delete_file() runs only in the shutdown sequence, under its except Exception (asy_system_service.py:498). Parameters are their mypy-checked annotations (D.2).
